purpose: Implementation summary and test evidence for the durable semantic-truth persistence layer designed in 09-semantic-truth-persistence-design.json.

implementationSummary.wiringPoint: lib/contract-model/analysis/orchestrator.ts's analyzeInstrument, immediately after independent semantic verification and before whole-document semantic coverage - every real rule/definition compilePackageToIR produced for the instrument, paired with the SemanticVerificationResult for the candidate it came from (null when verification never ran/threw for that candidate), is persisted via persistSemanticTruthForInstrument.
implementationSummary.noReimplementedLogic: The persistence layer contains ONLY mapping (IR object -> SemanticTruthTrustStatus) and upsert/read logic - it never re-derives compilation or verification conclusions, it only durably records what the already-fixed compiler/verifier modules already produced.
implementationSummary.genuineDefectFoundWhileBuildingTests: IRDefinition has no `operativeLineage` field (only IRRule does - a defined term's own mechanics are not themselves amended/superseded the way a rule's operative provision text can be); an early version of the persistence service accessed `object.operativeLineage` unconditionally, which `tsc` caught immediately (a compile-time type error, never reaching runtime) - fixed via a kind-discriminated `operativeLineageOf` helper that returns null for DEFINITION rows, never fabricated.

cases.name: a real, verified covenant produces a durable SemanticTruthRecord with the full required provenance/trust-gating shape
cases.proof: Real runContractAnalysis end-to-end run (scripted, deterministic discovery/compile callers, real Postgres, real structural/package-graph/discovery/compile/verify pipeline) produces a SemanticTruthRecord row with trustStatus VERIFIED, every required provenance field populated with real values (not placeholders), analysisRunId matching the real AnalysisRun.id, version 1, and a payload that deserializes to the real compiled IRRule (capacityExpression MONEY $10,000,000 matching the real source text).

cases.name: RELOAD WITHOUT RERUNNING AI (the phase's own required critical proof)
cases.method: After a real analysis run persists trusted semantic state, a BRAND NEW `new PrismaClient()` instance (never the shared `lib/prisma` singleton the orchestrator wrote through, and never any in-memory object `runContractAnalysis` returned) queries `semanticTruthRecord` directly.
cases.result: The fresh client's own independent query returns the real, trusted VERIFIED row with the correct sourceDocumentId and a payload whose capacityExpression/covenantFamily match the real compiled rule - proving the state is genuinely durable in Postgres, not merely held in the orchestrator's own process memory.
cases.significance: This is the literal proof the phase's charter names: 'simulate a process boundary... confirm you can re-read the trusted rule/definition state, with full provenance and trust status, directly from Postgres - not from any in-memory object the orchestrator returned.'

cases.name: TRUST GATING
cases.proof: 5 synthetic rules persisted directly via persistSemanticTruthForInstrument, covering every real trustStatus outcome (COMPILED/VERIFIED/CONTRADICTED/REVIEW_REQUIRED/UNSUPPORTED) in one call. getTrustedSemanticTruth returns EXACTLY the 1 VERIFIED row and nothing else; getAllSemanticTruthForInstrument returns all 5 with the correct trustStatus for each, including the UNSUPPORTED-sufficiency-wins-over-VERIFIED-verification case.

cases.name: IDEMPOTENCY / version bump
cases.proof: Re-persisting identical rule content twice: second call reports `unchanged: 1`, still exactly 1 row, version stays 1. A genuine content change (different capacityExpression amount, same ruleId) on the third call: reports `upserted: 1`, still exactly 1 row (same id), version becomes 2, and the new payload is what is stored.

testEvidence.pureUnitTests: computeTrustStatus tested against every real SemanticVerificationStatus value (7 values) plus the UNSUPPORTED-wins case; summarizeFindings tested for bounding (max 20 findings, max ~520 chars per reasoning string with a truncation marker) and the null-verification/zero-findings case returning null rather than an empty array (a real, disclosed distinction: null means 'nothing to summarize', matching this module's own convention elsewhere).

regressionEvidence.fullRelevantSuite: npx vitest run tests/contract-model tests/onboarding tests/foundation-audit tests/certification
regressionEvidence.result: 156/157 test files passing (1568/1570 tests) - the sole 2 failing tests (tests/certification/section11-source-trace-independent.test.ts) were independently confirmed, by running the identical command against the pristine pre-Workstream-H commit, to fail IDENTICALLY before any of this workstream's changes - a pre-existing, disclosed data-staleness issue in already-committed fixture rows (DefinedTermNode.stableKey format drift), unrelated to and untouched by this workstream.
regressionEvidence.typecheckAndLint: npx tsc --noEmit -p . : 0 new errors (6 pre-existing, exact baseline match). npx eslint . : 0 new errors (1 pre-existing, exact baseline match).

dispositionNote: The durable semantic-truth persistence layer is implemented, wired into the live orchestrator, and proven correct including the phase's own required 'reload without rerunning AI' critical test. Reserved CERTIFIED status for this phase's own separate, later, independent Part B.
